key_points: Multiple analyst downgrades (Baird, Morgan Stanley) cite slower AI spending and leadership risk.
Jensen Huang faces board investigation and political scrutiny, adding uncertainty.
Nvidia shares saw a short‑term rebound on AI demand optimism from CoreWeave and Nasdaq futures.
Upcoming earnings on Nov 17 could be a catalyst; supply‑chain and guidance concerns weigh.
Overall near‑term outlook tilted bearish amid mixed signals and elevated risk perception.
